tagline: Robotics and control, explained with the equations and the code.
description_footer: Remaining Action explains robotics and control research with original animations.

links.footer: Every number in the video comes from a script you can run: the explainer and its code are linked above.
links.note: Off: no link anywhere; on: the explainer and code links go in the YouTube description only (needs SITE_BASE_URL).

voice.pacing_note: Every narration block ends on a picture hold of block_end_pause_s, or of S when it ends with [pause S]; a [slow] block reads at azure.slow_rate_pct.

azure.max_break_note: The longest SSML break: a longer pause ends the block and holds the picture instead.
azure.note: A block over max_wpm gets breaks, then a slower rate down to pace_min_rate_pct (never below min_rate_pct); a take with a gap or under min_wpm is made again, up to retries times.

narrator.model: DragonHDLatest: follows Microsoft's latest model, not pinnable (no versioned name in the voice list, 2026-11-06)
narrator.reference: tools/video/voice_reference.py renders the fixed reference paragraph to voice-reference/ (git-ignored) at every voice change, for regression checks

voice.disclosure: Script, figures and animations were produced with an AI-assisted pipeline, checked by scripts and independent reviewers, and approved by a human before publication.
voice.policy: One narrator per series, AI narration always disclosed (README.md, voice policy).

video.loudness_note: Integrated loudness of the final mix (EBU R128); the true-peak ceiling is music.true_peak_dbtp.

linkedin.commentary_template: New on Remaining Action: {title}. {summary} Explainer with equations, code and sources: {explainer_url} Video: {video_url}

music.note: Original music from tools/video/music.py, mixed per scene (plan.json 'music', else modes_by_role): the bed sits bed_in_gaps_lu under the narration in pauses and bed_under_voice_lu under it while it speaks; source must stay 'generated'.
